_doc: Enemies for Combat.resolve. realm/stage give a baseline from realm power (see combat.gd); hp/attack/defense/speed are added on top. lethal: losing kills the player; otherwise the player is beaten, loses defeat_stone_loss of their spirit stones and spends recovery_days recovering. rewards use the shared Effects keys. techniques: technique ids the enemy knows at enemy_technique_level.
